archetypes.name: dyn-sidecar
archetypes.rationale: Security OOS sidecar privacy and rc=3 routing are the riskiest behavior changes.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the security OOS sidecar path across tally, design-log publish, disposition checkpoint, OOS filing, and ship pre-driver routing. Check that security observations cannot leak into public OOS artifacts or committed design logs. Verify mixed security and non-security OOS runs still file public items and keep private disposition pending. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
